scenario_description:
Objective: Keep LM-4627's patient portal pilot copy from carrying an avoidable enrollment-term ambiguity into Cascadia Care's immunization preview.
Emerging Need: A routine freeze becomes risky when the pilot adds immunization enrollment screens and QA shows the translations reuse account-signup wording.
Decision Context: The event stream separates ordinary scheduling from a narrow risk-note window; internal guidance and contacts identify who can confirm clinical program terminology before lock.
Consequence: If the ambiguity remains unraised before the pilot copy locks, patients and reviewers may see a misleading opt-in label, and later correction shifts to post-pilot cleanup.

parameter.title: LM-4627 pilot copy freeze checkpoint
parameter.description: Final risk notes for the patient portal pilot are accepted until the checkpoint starts; routine wording cleanup continues until then.

parameter.subject: Thursday pilot scope: immunization enrollment screens added
parameter.body: The Thursday patient portal pilot now includes the adult immunization program enrollment card alongside the existing portal-account enrollment pages. New screenshots are expected tomorrow morning; no terminology questions are currently open from the client side.

parameter.content: Vendor QA snapshot for LM-4627: rows APP-ENROLL-07 and IMM-OPT-02 both use the English source word "enrollment." Spanish currently repeats "inscripción" for both, and Tagalog repeats "pagpaparehistro" for both. QA did not file a defect because the English source is identical.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 pilot package queued for 13:30 risk-note cutoff
parameter.body: The queued pilot package includes IMM-OPT-02 on the immunization enrollment card and APP-ENROLL-07 on the portal-account registration page. Any client-risk note attached before 13:30 Pacific will be visible to the build reviewer; rows without notes at 13:30 will lock into pilot copy.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 pilot copy locked
parameter.body: Pilot rows APP-ENROLL-07 and IMM-OPT-02 locked at 13:30 Pacific with no attached client-risk note. New terminology notes for these rows will route to the post-pilot backlog rather than the Thursday preview build.
